overview:
California's 27th District leans Democratic by six points, and incumbent George Whitesides is seeking re-election with a commanding financial position. He has raised about $4.5 million and holds $2.2 million on hand, while Republican Jason Gibbs has raised roughly $414,000 with just $60,000 available. Outside groups have spent nearly half a million dollars supporting Whitesides, with virtually nothing opposing him.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the outlook rests on fundamentals. Prediction markets currently price a Democratic win at roughly 98 percent. The combination of incumbency, the district's Democratic lean, a favorable environment for Democrats this cycle, and an overwhelming money advantage makes Whitesides a strong favorite, though the absence of polling leaves some room for uncertainty.
